sourceBackedFact: The Rabozaal opened in2009 as a connection between the Stadsschouwburg and Melkweg. Its slender glazed lower structure supports an8m corridor and a foyer at15m that projects over the Melkweg and Lijnbaansgracht. Orange corrugated aluminium and dark perforated steel form the upper theater exterior.
